passages.title: 摔破螢幕的手機
passages.text: Last Tuesday, I {1} my phone on the floor at the MRT station, and the screen broke into a hundred tiny lines. I almost went {2}. All my photos and notes were in it, and I couldn't even turn it on. That evening, Dad took me to a small repair shop near our home. The owner looked at the phone for a minute and said he could {3} it in about an hour. But I didn't want to {4} any messages from my friends, so I borrowed Dad's old phone for the night. It was very slow and had a tiny screen, and I felt like I was living in the past. The next day, I got my phone back. It looked brand new! The owner also gave me a thick, hard case. "This will keep it {5} next time," he said with a smile. I hope there won't be a next time.

blanks.why: drop + 物「把…掉到地上」：手機掉在地上，螢幕破了。married、wore my phone 意思不通；fixed 和後面「螢幕破了」矛盾。
go crazy「快抓狂」：照片都在裡面，我急瘋了。go able、go own、go least 都不通。
fix + 物「修理」：老闆說一小時就能修好。marry、miss、wear it 意思不通。
miss messages「錯過訊息」：我不想漏掉朋友的訊息，所以借了爸爸的舊手機。fix、marry、wear messages 意思不通。
keep + 物 + safe「保護…安全」：這個殼可以保護手機。keep it least、keep it own、keep it than 都不通。

passages.zh: 上星期二，我在捷運站把手機摔到地上，螢幕裂成好幾百條細紋。我差點抓狂，所有的照片和筆記都在裡面，而且連開機都沒辦法。那天晚上，爸爸帶我去家附近一家小維修店。老闆看了手機一分鐘，說大概一小時就能修好。但我不想錯過朋友傳來的訊息，所以那晚先借了爸爸的舊手機。那支手機很慢、螢幕又小，我覺得自己好像活在過去。隔天，我拿回手機，看起來跟全新的一樣！老闆還送我一個又厚又硬的手機殼。「下次這個會保護它，」他笑著說。我希望不要有下次。

passages.title: 歷史老師的時光機
passages.text: Our {1} teacher, Mr. Chen, brought a strange metal box to class one morning. He said it was a time machine. Nobody believed him, and some students laughed. Then he pressed a red button. The room shook, and suddenly we were {2} to see the past. We were standing on a busy street in Tainan four hundred years ago! People {3} long robes and straw hats, and ships with big sails were coming into the harbor. A man was selling fish from a wooden cart. "Don't touch anything," Mr. Chen said. "It's {4} to change the past." Five minutes later, there was a loud noise, and we were back in our classroom. Was it real, or was it a dream? Nobody knows. But now everyone in our class loves history. No one wants to {5} Mr. Chen's class anymore.

blanks.why: history teacher「歷史老師」，後面的時光機和四百年前的台南都與歷史有關。hospital、weather、prize teacher 意思不通。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：我們突然能看到過去。own、least 不能接 to see；asleep to see 意思不通。
wear + 衣物「穿戴」：人們穿著長袍、戴草帽。dropped、fixed、married long robes 意思不通。
It's dangerous to + 動詞「做…很危險」：改變過去很危險。able、own、least 放在 It's … to 句型裡意思不通。
miss a class「錯過一堂課」：現在沒人想錯過陳老師的課。fix、wear、marry a class 意思不通。

passages.zh: 有一天早上，我們的歷史老師陳老師帶了一個奇怪的金屬盒子來上課。他說那是一台時光機。沒有人相信他，有些同學還笑了。接著他按下一個紅色按鈕，教室晃了起來，我們突然能看見過去了。我們站在四百年前台南一條熱鬧的街上！人們穿著長袍、戴著草帽，掛著大帆的船正駛進港口，還有一個人推著木頭推車在賣魚。「什麼都不要碰，」陳老師說，「改變過去是很危險的。」五分鐘後，一聲巨響，我們又回到了教室。那是真的，還是一場夢？沒人知道。但現在我們全班都愛上了歷史，再也沒有人想錯過陳老師的課。

passages.title: 阿姨的婚禮
passages.text: My aunt and her boyfriend got {1} last Saturday. They met in college ten years ago, and everyone in our family was so happy for them. My aunt {2} a beautiful white dress, and my uncle looked very handsome in a dark blue suit. I had an important job that day: I carried the rings. I was so nervous that my hands were shaking. Right in the middle of the ceremony, I {3} one of the rings on the floor! It rolled under a table, and the whole room became quiet. My face turned red. Then my uncle got down on his knees, picked it up, and said, "Don't worry, everyone. It's {4}!" Everyone laughed, and I felt better. My aunt is moving to Japan with my uncle next month. I will {5} her a lot, but she promised to call me every week.

blanks.why: get married「結婚」。get able、get own、get least 都不是正確的說法。
wear a dress「穿洋裝」。fixed、missed、married a white dress 意思不通。
drop + 物「把…弄掉」：我在典禮中把戒指掉到地上，後面說它滾到桌下。wore、married、fixed one of the rings on the floor 意思不通。
It's safe.「它沒事、很安全」：姨丈撿起戒指要大家別擔心。least、own、than 不能單獨放在 It's 後面。
miss + 人「想念某人」：阿姨要搬去日本，我會很想她。fix、drop、wear her 意思不通。

passages.zh: 上星期六，我阿姨和她男朋友結婚了。他們十年前在大學認識，全家人都替他們高興。阿姨穿著一件美麗的白色禮服，姨丈穿著深藍色西裝，看起來很帥。那天我有個重要的任務：負責拿戒指。我緊張到手一直發抖。就在典禮進行到一半時，我把其中一枚戒指掉到地上了！它滾到一張桌子底下，整個會場都安靜下來，我的臉都紅了。這時姨丈跪下來把戒指撿起來，說：「大家別擔心，戒指沒事！」大家都笑了，我也覺得好多了。阿姨下個月要跟姨丈搬去日本，我會很想她，但她答應每個星期都會打電話給我。

passages.title: 穿錯鞋的早晨
passages.text: I {1} the school bus again this morning. My alarm clock has been broken for a week, and I keep forgetting to {2} it. When I woke up, it was already seven fifteen. I jumped out of bed, put on my uniform, and ran out the door with a piece of toast in my mouth. I ran all the way to school. When I got to the classroom, everyone started laughing. I looked down. I {3} two different shoes: one black and one white! My classmates thought I was {4}. Some of them even took photos. My face was as red as a tomato. But my teacher just smiled and said, "At least you were {5} to get here before the test." That afternoon, I went straight to the store and bought a new alarm clock. I'm not going to make the same mistake again.

blanks.why: miss the bus「錯過公車」。fixed、wore、married the school bus 意思不通。
forget to fix it「忘了修好它」，it 指壞掉的鬧鐘。miss、wear、marry it 意思不通。
wear shoes「穿鞋子」：我穿了兩隻不一樣的鞋。fixed、married、missed two different shoes 意思不通。
think + 人 + crazy「覺得某人瘋了」。able、own、least 不能這樣形容人。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：至少你能在考試前趕到。own、than 不能接 to get；asleep to get here 意思不通。

passages.zh: 今天早上，我又錯過校車了。我的鬧鐘已經壞了一個星期，我一直忘記把它修好。醒來時已經七點十五分了。我跳下床，穿上制服，嘴裡咬著一片吐司就衝出門，一路跑到學校。我走進教室時，大家都開始大笑。我低頭一看，我穿了兩隻不一樣的鞋：一隻黑色、一隻白色！同學們都覺得我瘋了，有些人還拍照。我的臉紅得像番茄一樣。但老師只是笑著說：「至少你在考試前趕到了。」那天下午，我直接去店裡買了一個新鬧鐘。我不會再犯同樣的錯了。

passages.title: 瓦力的寶物
passages.text: WALL-E is a small robot, and he lives alone on Earth. Many years ago, Earth became too dirty and {1} for people, so they all left in giant spaceships. WALL-E's job is to clean up the trash. But he also likes to collect old things and {2} them. He {3} everything in his little home: a light bulb, a spoon, and an old video of people dancing. One day, a white robot named EVE landed near him. WALL-E liked her right away. He showed her all his treasures. But one day, a spaceship came and took EVE away. WALL-E {4} her so much that he held on to the outside of the ship and flew into space. It was a crazy idea, but it worked. After a long journey, he was {5} to find her again. Love can make even a little robot very brave.

blanks.why: too dirty and dangerous「太髒又太危險」：地球不適合人住，所以人們離開了。able、own、least 不能和 dirty 並列形容地球。
fix + 物「修理」：他喜歡收集舊東西並把它們修好。marry、miss、wear them 意思不通。
keep + 物 + in + 地方「把…收在某處」。answers、marries、travels everything 意思不通。
miss + 人「想念某人」：瓦力太想念伊芙，所以跟著太空船飛走。fixed、wore、married her 放在這裡意思不通。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：他終於能再找到她。own、least 不能接 to find；asleep to find 意思不通。

passages.zh: 瓦力是一個小機器人，他獨自住在地球上。很多年前，地球變得太髒又太危險，人類全都搭著巨大的太空船離開了。瓦力的工作是清理垃圾，但他也喜歡收集舊東西，再把它們修好。他把所有東西都收在自己的小家裡：一個燈泡、一支湯匙，還有一段人們跳舞的舊影片。有一天，一個叫伊芙的白色機器人降落在他附近，瓦力馬上就喜歡上她，把他所有的寶物都給她看。但有一天，一艘太空船來把伊芙帶走了。瓦力太想念她，於是緊抓著太空船外面，一起飛上了太空。那是個瘋狂的主意，但居然成功了。經過一段漫長的旅程，他終於再次找到了她。愛，能讓一個小機器人變得非常勇敢。

passages.title: 表哥的安全帽
passages.text: In Taiwan, many students ride bikes to school, but some of them don't {1} helmets. My cousin Eric used to be one of them. He thought helmets looked {2} and messed up his hair. Last year, he was riding to school when a car turned in front of him without warning. He fell off his bike and hit his head on the road. Luckily, his mom had made him wear a helmet that day. The helmet broke into two pieces, but his head was {3}. He only had a few cuts on his arms. The doctor at the hospital told him, "Riding without a helmet is very {4}. You were lucky." Now Eric always wears his helmet, and he even checks mine. Last week, when the strap on my helmet broke, he helped me {5} it right away. "No helmet, no ride," he said.

blanks.why: wear a helmet「戴安全帽」。fix、miss、marry helmets 意思不通。
look crazy「看起來很蠢、很怪」：他覺得戴安全帽很怪又會弄亂頭髮。able、own、least 不能放在 look 後面形容外表。
his head was safe「他的頭沒事」：安全帽破了，但保護了頭。least、own、than 不能單獨當補語。
It's dangerous to …／V-ing is dangerous「…很危險」：不戴安全帽騎車很危險。able、own、least 放在這裡意思不通。
help + 人 + fix it「幫某人修好它」。miss、marry、travel it 意思不通。

passages.zh: 在台灣，很多學生騎腳踏車上學，但有些人不戴安全帽。我表哥 Eric 以前就是其中之一。他覺得戴安全帽很蠢，還會弄亂頭髮。去年，他騎車上學時，一輛車沒打方向燈就在他前面轉彎。他從車上摔下來，頭撞到路面。幸好那天他媽媽逼他戴了安全帽。安全帽裂成兩半，但他的頭沒事，只有手臂擦傷了幾處。醫院的醫生跟他說：「騎車不戴安全帽很危險，你很幸運。」現在 Eric 每次都戴安全帽，甚至還會檢查我的。上星期我的安全帽帶子斷了，他馬上幫我修好。「沒戴安全帽，就不准騎，」他說。

passages.title: 一台壞掉的腳踏車
passages.text: My grandparents have been {1} for fifty years. Last night at dinner, I asked them how they met. Grandma smiled and told me the story. When they were young, Grandpa worked in a small bike shop in Changhua. One day, the chain on Grandma's bike broke, and she asked him to {2} it. He fixed it in ten minutes. But he told her it would take two days. "Why?" I asked Grandpa. He laughed. "I didn't want to {3} the chance to see her again!" After that, Grandma's bike seemed to break every week. A year later, they had their wedding. Grandma {4} a red dress, and Grandpa rode her home on the back of his bike. "So our family {5} started with a broken bike," Grandma said. Grandpa held her hand and winked. "Best bike I ever fixed."

blanks.why: have been married for + 時間「已經結婚多久」。able、own、least 不能接 for fifty years 表示婚姻。
ask + 人 + to fix it「請某人修理它」，it 指斷了鏈條的腳踏車。miss、wear、marry it 意思不通。
miss the chance「錯過機會」：爺爺不想錯過再見到奶奶的機會。fix、wear、marry the chance 意思不通。
wear a dress「穿洋裝」：婚禮那天奶奶穿紅色洋裝。missed、fixed、married a red dress 意思不通。
family history「家族史」：我們家的故事從一台壞掉的腳踏車開始。hospital、weather、prize 和 family 搭配意思不通。

passages.zh: 我爺爺奶奶已經結婚五十年了。昨天晚餐時，我問他們是怎麼認識的。奶奶笑著說起了這個故事。年輕的時候，爺爺在彰化一家小腳踏車店工作。有一天，奶奶的腳踏車鏈條斷了，她請爺爺幫忙修。爺爺十分鐘就修好了，卻跟她說要兩天才會好。「為什麼？」我問爺爺。他笑了：「我不想錯過再見到她的機會啊！」在那之後，奶奶的腳踏車好像每個星期都會壞。一年後，他們舉行了婚禮。奶奶穿著紅色洋裝，爺爺騎著腳踏車載她回家。「所以我們家的故事，是從一台壞掉的腳踏車開始的，」奶奶說。爺爺握著她的手眨了眨眼：「那是我修過最好的一台車。」

passages.title: 想念台灣的德國同學
passages.text: Last year, Lucas came from Germany to study at our school for a year. At first, everything was new to him. He went {1} for bubble tea and drank two cups a day. He also loved our {2} class, because he learned about Taiwan's past and the different groups of people who came here. Lucas was used to cold weather, so in winter, he {3} shorts and T-shirts while the rest of us wore thick coats. Everyone thought he was super brave. Now Lucas is back in Germany. He sends us messages almost every day. He says he {4} the night markets, the convenience stores, and most of all, his friends. He also says German bubble tea is not as good. He's saving money right now, and he hopes he will be {5} to come back next summer. We have already planned a welcome party for him.

blanks.why: go crazy for + 東西「瘋狂迷上…」：他迷上珍奶，一天喝兩杯。able、own、least for bubble tea 意思不通。
history class「歷史課」，後面說他學到台灣的過去。hospital、weather、prize class 意思不通。
wear shorts「穿短褲」：冬天他還穿短褲和 T 恤。fixed、married、missed shorts 意思不通。
miss + 事物「懷念、想念」：他想念夜市和便利商店。fixes、wears、marries the night markets 意思不通。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：他希望明年夏天能回來。own、least 不能接 to come；asleep to come back 意思不通。

passages.zh: 去年，Lucas 從德國來我們學校讀一年書。一開始，所有東西對他來說都很新鮮。他迷上了珍珠奶茶，一天要喝兩杯。他也很喜歡我們的歷史課，因為他學到台灣的過去，還有來到這裡的不同族群。Lucas 習慣了寒冷的天氣，所以冬天我們都穿厚外套時，他還穿著短褲和 T 恤，大家都覺得他超勇敢。現在 Lucas 回德國了，他幾乎每天都傳訊息給我們。他說他好想念夜市、便利商店，最想念的是朋友們。他還說德國的珍奶沒那麼好喝。他現在正在存錢，希望明年夏天能再回來。我們已經幫他計畫好一場歡迎派對了。

passages.title: 颱風天的海邊
passages.text: When a typhoon is coming, the sea becomes very {1}. The waves can be more than five meters high. But every year, some people still go to the beach to take photos. Last summer, during a strong typhoon, a group of young men went to a beach in Yilan. They stood on the rocks and took videos of the giant waves. Everyone watching thought they were {2}. Suddenly, a big wave hit one of them. He fell into the water and {3} his phone into the sea. Luckily, two lifeguards were nearby. By the time the police arrived, the lifeguards had {4} pulled him out. He was {5}, but his phone was gone forever. When my dad saw this on the news, he turned to me and said, "Remember this. You can always buy a new phone, but you can't buy a new life."

blanks.why: become dangerous「變得危險」：颱風來時海浪很高，海很危險。able、own、least 不能這樣形容大海。
think + 人 + crazy「覺得某人瘋了」：颱風天站在岩石上拍浪。able、own、least 不能這樣形容人。
drop + 物 + into …「把…掉進…」：他把手機掉進海裡。wore、married his phone 意思不通；fixed 和「掉進海裡」不合。
had already + 過去分詞「已經…了」：警察到的時候，救生員已經把他拉上來了。than、whether、below 不能放在 had 和 pulled 中間。
He was safe.「他平安無事」。least、own、than 不能單獨放在 was 後面當補語。

passages.zh: 颱風要來的時候，海會變得非常危險，浪可能高達五公尺以上。但每年還是有人跑去海邊拍照。去年夏天一個強颱來襲時，一群年輕人跑到宜蘭的海邊，站在岩石上拍巨浪的影片，旁人都覺得他們瘋了。突然，一道大浪打中其中一人，他掉進水裡，手機也掉進海裡。幸好附近有兩名救生員。警察趕到的時候，救生員已經把他拉上岸了。他平安無事，但手機永遠找不回來了。爸爸在新聞上看到這件事時，轉過來對我說：「記住，手機壞了可以再買，但命只有一條。」

passages.title: 赤崁樓的石龜
passages.text: Last month, our class took a trip to Chihkan Tower in Tainan. It is one of the oldest buildings in Taiwan, and it has a long {1}. It was first built by the Dutch in 1653. Over the years, it was damaged many times by earthquakes and wars, but people {2} it again and again. Our guide {3} old-style clothes and told us funny stories about the past. My best friend Jay is {4} about history, so he asked the guide about a hundred questions. In the garden, there are nine stone turtles with big stone signs on their backs. Visitors are not allowed to climb on them, but we were {5} to touch their heads. The guide said that touching them brings good luck. Jay touched all nine. "Now I'll get a perfect score on my history test," he said. We'll see!

blanks.why: have a long history「有悠久的歷史」。hospital、weather、prize 和 long 搭配意思不通。
fix + 物「修復」：建築被地震和戰爭破壞，人們一再修復它。wore、married、missed it 意思不通。
wear clothes「穿衣服」：導覽員穿著古裝。fixed、married、missed old-style clothes 意思不通。
be crazy about + 事物「非常熱愛…」：Jay 超愛歷史。able、own、least about history 意思不通。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：不能爬上去，但可以摸牠們的頭。own、least 不能接 to touch；asleep to touch 意思不通。

passages.zh: 上個月，我們班去台南的赤崁樓校外教學。那是台灣最古老的建築之一，有很悠久的歷史，最早是荷蘭人在 1653 年建的。多年來，它被地震和戰爭破壞了很多次，但人們一次又一次地修復它。我們的導覽員穿著古裝，講了很多過去的趣事。我最好的朋友 Jay 超愛歷史，問了導覽員大概一百個問題。花園裡有九隻石龜，背上各馱著一塊大石碑。遊客不能爬上去，但可以摸摸牠們的頭。導覽員說摸了會帶來好運，Jay 九隻全摸了。「這樣我歷史考試就會考滿分，」他說。等著看吧！

passages.title: 爸爸自己修水管
passages.text: Last Sunday, the pipe under our kitchen sink started leaking. Mom wanted to call someone, but Dad said, "No problem. I can {1} it myself. I watched a video online." He {2} a pair of old gloves and lay down under the sink. For twenty minutes, we heard him talking to himself. Then he {3} his heavy tool, and it hit the pipe hard. Water shot out everywhere! Mom and I ran around with towels, but the water kept coming. Soon, the kitchen floor looked like a small swimming pool. Our dog went {4} and started jumping and splashing in the water. Finally, Mom called a plumber. He came in half an hour and was {5} to fix everything in ten minutes. Dad looked a little embarrassed. "Well," he said, "at least now our kitchen floor is very clean."

blanks.why: fix + 物「修理」：爸爸說他可以自己修好。miss、marry、wear it 意思不通。
wear gloves「戴手套」。missed、married、answered a pair of gloves 意思不通。
drop + 物「把…掉下去」：工具掉下去撞到水管，水就噴出來。wore、married his tool 意思不通；fixed 和後面「撞到水管」不合。
go crazy「發狂、興奮得不得了」：狗在水裡跳來跳去。go able、go own、go least 都不通。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：水電工十分鐘就修好了。own、least 不能接 to fix；asleep to fix 意思不通。

passages.zh: 上星期天，廚房水槽下面的水管開始漏水。媽媽想找人來修，但爸爸說：「沒問題，我自己就能修好，我在網路上看過影片。」他戴上一雙舊手套，躺到水槽下面。二十分鐘裡，我們一直聽到他在自言自語。接著他手上的重工具掉了下去，重重撞到水管，水一下子噴得到處都是！媽媽和我拿著毛巾跑來跑去，但水一直流。很快地，廚房地板就像一個小游泳池。我們家的狗興奮得發狂，在水裡又跳又濺水。最後，媽媽打電話叫了水電工。他半小時後就到了，十分鐘就把一切修好。爸爸看起來有點不好意思。「嗯，」他說，「至少現在我們的廚房地板很乾淨。」

passages.title: 高塔裡的長髮公主
passages.text: Rapunzel lived in a tall tower in the middle of a forest. She had never been outside. Her mother told her again and again that the world was {1}. "There are bad people everywhere," she said. "You're only {2} in this tower." Every year on her birthday, Rapunzel watched thousands of floating lights rise into the night sky. She never {3} them, and she always wondered what they were. One day, a thief named Flynn climbed into the tower to hide. Rapunzel asked him to take her to see the lights. At first, she was very scared. She {4} a simple purple dress and walked on the grass with bare feet for the first time. Then she laughed and ran. On her birthday, she was finally {5} to see the lights up close. She learned that the world isn't only scary. It's also full of beautiful things.

blanks.why: the world was dangerous「外面的世界很危險」，後面說到處都是壞人。able、own、least 不能這樣形容世界。
be safe in + 地方「在某處很安全」：你只有在塔裡才安全。least、own、than 不能當補語放在 You're only 後面。
never miss + 事物「從不錯過」：她每年都看天燈。fixed、wore、married them 意思不通。
wear a dress「穿洋裝」。fixed、married、missed a purple dress 意思不通。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：她終於能近距離看到天燈。own、least 不能接 to see；asleep to see 意思不通。

passages.zh: 樂佩住在森林中央的一座高塔裡，從來沒出去過。她的母親一再告訴她，外面的世界很危險。「到處都是壞人，」她說，「你只有在這座塔裡才安全。」每年生日，樂佩都會看到成千上萬盞漂浮的燈升上夜空。她從來沒錯過，也一直很好奇那些到底是什麼。有一天，一個叫佛林的小偷爬進塔裡躲藏。樂佩請他帶她去看那些燈。一開始，她非常害怕。她穿著一件簡單的紫色洋裝，第一次赤腳走在草地上。接著她笑了，跑了起來。生日那天，她終於能近距離看到那些燈。她明白了：世界不是只有可怕的一面，也充滿了美好的事物。

passages.title: 瘋狂帽子日
passages.text: Every year in May, our school has Crazy Hat Day. On that day, everyone can {1} any hat they like to class. Last year, my friend Ken made a hat that looked like a giant birthday cake, with real candles on top. The teachers made him take the candles out. This year, I made a hat that looked like a fish tank, with paper fish inside. But it was too heavy. On the way to school, it {2} off my head and fell into a puddle. One side was broken, so I had to {3} it with tape before the first class. At ten o'clock, we all walked around the playground in a parade. Then our principal appeared in a hat shaped like a huge yellow chicken. The whole school went {4}! Everyone clapped and shouted. I took a lot of photos because I didn't want to {5} anything. It was the best day of the year.

blanks.why: wear a hat「戴帽子」。fix、miss、marry any hat they like 意思不通。
drop off + 地方「從…掉下來」：帽子從頭上掉進水坑。married、fixed、missed off my head 都不通。
fix + 物 + with tape「用膠帶修好」。miss、marry、drop it with tape 意思不通。
go crazy「（群眾）陷入瘋狂、high 翻天」：全校看到校長的帽子都瘋了。go able、go own、go least 都不通。
not want to miss anything「不想錯過任何事」，所以拍很多照片。fix、marry、wear anything 意思不通。

passages.zh: 每年五月，我們學校都有「瘋狂帽子日」。那天，每個人都可以戴任何喜歡的帽子來上課。去年，我朋友 Ken 做了一頂像大生日蛋糕的帽子，上面還插著真的蠟燭，結果老師叫他把蠟燭拿掉。今年，我做了一頂像魚缸的帽子，裡面有紙做的魚，但它太重了。上學途中，帽子從我頭上掉下來，掉進一個水坑裡。有一邊破了，我只好在第一節課前用膠帶把它修好。十點的時候，我們全部在操場上繞圈遊行。接著校長出現了，她戴著一頂像巨大黃色小雞的帽子。全校都瘋了！大家又拍手又尖叫。我拍了好多照片，因為我什麼都不想錯過。那是一年裡最棒的一天。

passages.title: 掉在地上的冰淇淋
passages.text: On a hot afternoon, my little brother Leo {1} his favorite dinosaur hat to the park. He bought an ice cream cone with his own money for the first time, and he was so proud. But after just two bites, he tripped and {2} it on the ground. Leo looked at the ice cream for a second. Then he started crying so loudly that everyone in the park stared at us. I wanted to pick it up for him, but Mom always says it's not {3} to eat food that falls on the ground. The ice cream man saw everything. He waved at Leo and said, "Don't cry, little dinosaur. I'll {4} you another one." Leo stopped crying right away. This time, he held the cone with both hands and walked very slowly. He ate every bit of it and didn't {5} a single drop.

blanks.why: wear a hat「戴帽子」：弟弟戴著他最喜歡的恐龍帽去公園。fixed、married、missed his hat 意思不通。
drop + 物「把…掉落」：他絆倒，把冰淇淋掉在地上。married、wore it 意思不通；fixed 和後面哭出來不合。
It's not safe to + 動詞「…不安全」：掉在地上的食物吃了不安全。least、own、than 不能放在 It's not … to 句型裡。
get + 人 + 物「幫某人拿／買…」：我再拿一支給你。learn、change、start you another one 意思不通。
not miss a single drop「一滴都沒浪費」：他吃得乾乾淨淨。fix、marry、wear a single drop 意思不通。

passages.zh: 一個炎熱的下午，我弟弟 Leo 戴著他最喜歡的恐龍帽去公園。他第一次用自己的錢買了一支冰淇淋甜筒，非常得意。可是才吃了兩口，他就絆了一下，把冰淇淋掉在地上。Leo 盯著冰淇淋看了一秒，接著哭得超大聲，公園裡每個人都盯著我們看。我想幫他撿起來，但媽媽總是說掉在地上的食物吃了不安全。賣冰淇淋的叔叔全都看到了，他對 Leo 揮揮手說：「別哭，小恐龍，我再拿一支給你。」Leo 馬上不哭了。這一次，他用雙手握著甜筒，走得很慢很慢。他把整支吃得乾乾淨淨，一滴都沒浪費。

passages.title: 歷史博物館的夜晚
passages.text: Mr. Wu works as a night guard at the city {1} museum. His job is to walk around the building and keep everything {2}. For ten years, nothing special happened. Then one night, something {3} happened. At midnight, the old statues and skeletons came alive! A stone soldier began to march down the hall. A small dinosaur skeleton took Mr. Wu's hat and {4} it on its head. Some of the animals were {5}, like a huge tiger with sharp teeth, so Mr. Wu hid behind a door. But soon he noticed that the tiger only wanted someone to play with. Mr. Wu threw a ball, and the tiger ran after it like a puppy. When the sun came up, everything went back to its place. The next morning, Mr. Wu told his boss, but nobody believed him. Only the dinosaur knew where his hat was.

blanks.why: history museum「歷史博物館」，裡面有古老的雕像和骨骼。hospital、weather、prize museum 意思不通。
keep + 物 + safe「保護…安全」：警衛的工作是保護館內一切。keep everything least／own／than 都不通。
something crazy「瘋狂的事」，形容詞放在 something 後面。able、own、least 不能這樣修飾 something。
wear + 物 + on one's head「把…戴在頭上」。missed、married、answered it on its head 意思不通。
be dangerous「危險的」：有些動物很危險，例如牙齒尖銳的大老虎。able、own、least 不能這樣形容動物。

passages.zh: 吳先生在市立歷史博物館當夜班警衛。他的工作是在館內巡邏，保護一切安全。十年來，什麼特別的事都沒發生過。後來有一天晚上，發生了一件瘋狂的事。午夜時，那些古老的雕像和骨骼全活了過來！一個石頭士兵開始沿著走廊行進，一副小恐龍骨骼拿走吳先生的帽子戴在自己頭上。有些動物很危險，像是一隻牙齒尖利的大老虎，所以吳先生躲到門後面。但很快他就發現，那隻老虎只是想找人玩。吳先生丟了一顆球，老虎就像小狗一樣追了過去。太陽升起時，一切又回到原位。隔天早上，吳先生把這件事告訴老闆，但沒有人相信他。只有那隻恐龍知道他的帽子在哪裡。

passages.title: 姊姊的男朋友來吃飯
passages.text: My sister and her boyfriend, Tom, have been together for three years. Last Sunday, Tom came to our house for dinner. He had something important to say: he wanted to {1} my sister. He {2} a white shirt and a tie, even though it was thirty-three degrees outside. He was so nervous that he {3} his chopsticks twice before the soup came. After dinner, Tom finally told my parents. Then there was a long silence. Dad didn't say a word. He just looked at Tom. Tom's face turned red, and he looked like he was going to go {4}. My sister held his hand under the table. Finally, Dad smiled and asked, "Can you {5} a computer? Mine has been broken for a week." Tom said yes, and everyone started laughing. "Then welcome to the family," Dad said.

blanks.why: want to marry + 人「想娶／嫁給某人」，後面說他要向爸媽提這件重要的事。miss、wear、fix my sister 意思不通。
wear a shirt and a tie「穿襯衫打領帶」。dropped、married、fixed a white shirt 意思不通。
drop + 物「把…弄掉」：他緊張到筷子掉了兩次。married、wore、fixed his chopsticks 意思不通。
go crazy「快瘋掉」：爸爸一直不說話，Tom 緊張得要命。go able、go own、go least 都不通。
fix a computer「修電腦」：爸爸的電腦壞了一週。miss、marry、wear a computer 意思不通。

passages.zh: 我姊姊和她男朋友 Tom 已經交往三年了。上星期天，Tom 來我們家吃晚餐。他有一件很重要的事要說：他想娶我姊姊。雖然外面有三十三度，他還是穿了白襯衫、打了領帶。他緊張到湯還沒上，筷子就掉了兩次。晚餐後，Tom 終於跟我爸媽說了。接著是一段很長的沉默，爸爸一句話也沒說，只是看著 Tom。Tom 的臉都紅了，看起來快瘋掉了。姊姊在桌子底下握著他的手。最後，爸爸笑著問：「你會修電腦嗎？我的已經壞一個禮拜了。」Tom 說會，大家都笑了出來。「那就歡迎加入我們家，」爸爸說。

passages.title: 河濱的爆胎
passages.text: On Saturday afternoon, my friend Ann and I rode our bikes along the Tamsui River. It was sunny and windy, and we sang songs as we rode. But halfway there, my back tire went flat. Neither of us knew how to {1} it. We didn't have any tools, either. The sun was going down, and riding on a flat tire in the dark was {2}. We were also worried that we would {3} the last train home. Then an old man on a bike stopped next to us. He {4} a bright yellow jacket and a helmet covered in stickers. "Need help?" he asked. He took out a small repair kit from his bag. In just five minutes, he was {5} to fix my tire. Before he left, he said, "Always carry one of these." Now I never ride without my own repair kit.

blanks.why: know how to fix it「知道怎麼修」，it 指爆胎的輪胎。miss、marry、wear it 意思不通。
V-ing is dangerous「做…很危險」：天黑騎著沒氣的輪胎很危險。able、own、least 放在這裡意思不通。
miss the last train「錯過末班車」。fix、wear、marry the last train 意思不通。
wear a jacket「穿外套」。fixed、married、missed a yellow jacket 意思不通。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：他五分鐘就修好了。own、least 不能接 to fix；asleep to fix 意思不通。

passages.zh: 星期六下午，我和朋友 Ann 沿著淡水河騎腳踏車。天氣晴朗、風很大，我們一邊騎一邊唱歌。但騎到一半，我的後輪爆胎了。我們兩個都不知道怎麼修，也沒帶任何工具。太陽快下山了，天黑時騎著沒氣的輪胎很危險，我們也擔心會錯過回家的末班車。這時，一位騎腳踏車的老伯伯停在我們旁邊。他穿著亮黃色的外套，戴著貼滿貼紙的安全帽。「需要幫忙嗎？」他問。他從包包裡拿出一套小修理工具，只花了五分鐘就把我的輪胎修好了。離開前他說：「出門一定要帶一套。」現在我騎車都會帶著自己的修理工具組。

passages.title: 夾不到的娃娃
passages.text: My classmate Danny is {1} about claw machines. Almost every day after school, he goes to the shop on the corner and spends his pocket money there. He says he can almost win a toy every time, but then the claw {2} it at the last second. Last Friday, I went with him. He tried twenty times, and he {3} every time. His face got redder and redder. Then a little girl walked in with her mom. She put in one coin, moved the claw for two seconds, and was {4} to catch a big pink bear on her first try! Danny's mouth fell open. "That machine must be broken," he said. "Someone should {5} it." I laughed so hard that my stomach hurt. Since then, Danny has stopped going to that shop. Now he says he's saving his money for something better.

blanks.why: be crazy about + 事物「非常熱愛…」：Danny 超迷夾娃娃機。able、own、least about claw machines 意思不通。
drop + 物「把…放掉、掉下」：夾子在最後一秒把娃娃掉下來。wears、marries、fixes it 意思不通。
miss「沒夾中、失手」：他夾了二十次，每次都沒中。fixed、wore、married every time 意思不通。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：小女孩第一次就夾到大熊。own、least 不能接 to catch；asleep to catch 意思不通。
fix + 物「修理」：Danny 說機器一定壞了，該有人來修。miss、marry、wear it 意思不通。

passages.zh: 我同學 Danny 超迷夾娃娃機。他幾乎每天放學都去轉角那家店，把零用錢花在那裡。他說他每次都差一點就夾到，可是夾子總在最後一秒把娃娃掉下來。上星期五，我跟他一起去。他夾了二十次，每次都沒中，臉越來越紅。這時，一個小女孩跟媽媽走進來。她投了一枚硬幣，移動夾子兩秒鐘，第一次就夾到一隻粉紅色大熊！Danny 嘴巴張得大大的。「那台機器一定壞了，」他說，「應該要有人來修。」我笑到肚子痛。從那以後，Danny 就不再去那家店了。現在他說他要把錢存下來，買更好的東西。

passages.title: 半夜三點的地震
passages.text: At three in the morning, our whole building started shaking. I woke up and heard things falling. Books {1} off my shelves, and the lamp on my desk fell to the floor. I remembered what we had practiced at school: drop, cover, and hold on. I got under my desk and held its legs tightly. I stayed there until it was {2} to come out. Mom ran into my room with a flashlight. "Are you OK?" she asked. I nodded, but my legs were still shaking. In the living room, a window was broken, and there was glass all over the floor. Dad said it was {3} to walk around without shoes, so we all put on our sneakers. Nobody was {4} to fall asleep again that night. We sat on the sofa and watched the news until the sun came up. The next day, a worker came to {5} the window.

blanks.why: drop off + 地方「從…掉落」：書從書架上掉下來。married、wore、missed off my shelves 意思不通。
until it was safe to + 動詞「直到可以安全地…」。least、own、than 不能放在 it was … to 句型裡。
It's dangerous to + 動詞「做…很危險」：地上有玻璃，不穿鞋走路很危險。able、own、least 放在這裡意思不通。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：那晚沒人能再睡著。own、least 不能接 to fall；asleep to fall asleep 意思不通。
fix the window「修窗戶」：隔天工人來修破掉的窗戶。miss、marry、wear the window 意思不通。

passages.zh: 凌晨三點，我們整棟大樓開始搖晃。我醒過來，聽到東西掉落的聲音。書從架子上掉下來，書桌上的檯燈也摔到地上。我想起在學校練習過的：趴下、掩護、穩住。我躲到書桌底下，緊緊抓住桌腳，一直待到安全了才出來。媽媽拿著手電筒衝進我房間。「你還好嗎？」她問。我點點頭，但腿還在發抖。客廳有一扇窗戶破了，地上到處都是玻璃。爸爸說不穿鞋走來走去很危險，所以我們都穿上了運動鞋。那天晚上沒有人能再睡著。我們坐在沙發上看新聞，一直到太陽出來。隔天，工人來把窗戶修好了。

passages.title: 尋找尼莫
passages.text: Marlin is a clownfish, and he lives in the sea with his only son, Nemo. Marlin worries about everything. He thinks the ocean is too {1}, and he wants to keep Nemo {2} all the time. On Nemo's first day of school, Nemo wanted to show his friends how brave he was. He swam away to touch the bottom of a boat. Suddenly, a diver caught him and took him onto the boat. Marlin swam after it as fast as he could, but he {3} it by a few seconds. Later, Marlin met a blue fish named Dory. She couldn't remember anything for more than a few minutes, but she was {4} to read the words on the diver's mask. Together, they {5} across the ocean to find Nemo. On the way, Marlin learned that being a good father doesn't mean keeping your child away from the whole world.

blanks.why: too dangerous「太危險」：馬林覺得大海太危險。able、own、least 不能這樣形容大海。
keep + 人 + safe「保護某人安全」。keep Nemo least／own／than 都不通。
miss + 交通工具「沒趕上」：他差幾秒沒追上那艘船。fixed、wore、married it 意思不通。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：多莉記性差，卻看得懂面罩上的字。own、least 不能接 to read；asleep to read 意思不通。
travel across the ocean「橫越大海」：他們一起穿越大海去找尼莫。waited、interested、grew across the ocean 意思不通。

passages.zh: 馬林是一條小丑魚，和他唯一的兒子尼莫住在海裡。馬林什麼都擔心，他覺得大海太危險，一直想把尼莫保護得好好的。尼莫上學第一天，想讓朋友們看看他有多勇敢，就游過去摸一艘船的底部。突然，一個潛水員抓住他，把他帶上了船。馬林拚命追過去，卻差了幾秒沒追上。後來，馬林遇到一條叫多莉的藍色魚。她什麼事都記不了幾分鐘，卻看得懂潛水員面罩上的字。他們一起橫越大海去找尼莫。在路上，馬林學到：當個好爸爸，不代表要讓孩子遠離整個世界。

passages.title: 外婆家的老狗
passages.text: When I was little, I lived with my grandma in Pingtung. She had a big brown dog named Lucky. Every morning, Lucky walked me to school and waited at the gate to make sure I was {1}. When I was ten, my family moved to Taipei. Grandma said Lucky was too old for the city, so he had to stay with her. I {2} him so much that I cried every night for a month. Last winter, I finally went back to visit. Lucky was very old now. His face was gray, and he wasn't {3} to run anymore. But when he saw me, his tail moved so fast that his whole body shook. He {4} remembered me after all these years! I took off my scarf and {5} it on the floor, and Lucky lay down on it right away. Grandma smiled. "He knows it smells like you," she said.

blanks.why: make sure + 人 + is safe「確保某人平安」。least、own、than 不能當補語放在 was 後面。
miss + 人／動物「想念」：我想念 Lucky 想到每晚都哭。fixed、wore、married him 意思不通。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：牠老了，不能再跑了。own、least 不能接 to run；asleep to run 意思不通。
still「仍然」：過了這麼多年，牠還記得我。least、below、than 不能放在主詞和動詞 remembered 中間。
drop + 物 + on the floor「把…丟在地上」：我把圍巾放到地上，狗就躺上去。wore、married、missed it on the floor 意思不通。

passages.zh: 我小時候和外婆一起住在屏東。她養了一隻叫 Lucky 的棕色大狗。每天早上，Lucky 都陪我走路上學，還會在校門口等著，確定我平安進去。我十歲時，我們家搬到台北。外婆說 Lucky 太老了，不適合住在城市，所以牠得留下來陪她。我好想念牠，整整一個月每晚都在哭。去年冬天，我終於回去看牠。Lucky 已經很老了，臉上的毛都白了，也不能再跑了。但牠一看到我，尾巴搖得好快，整個身體都在晃。過了這麼多年，牠還記得我！我把圍巾脫下來放在地上，Lucky 馬上就躺了上去。外婆笑著說：「牠知道上面有你的味道。」

passages.title: 外星人的地球穿搭
passages.text: Zog is an alien from a small purple planet. His teacher sent him to Earth to study human {1}. Before he left, Zog read some very old books about Earth and its fashion. So when he landed in Taipei, he {2} a long silver cape, a tall black hat, and swimming goggles. People on the street stopped and stared at him. A boy pointed and shouted, "That's {3}!" Zog felt worried. He didn't understand why everyone was looking at him. Was he {4} here? Then the boy walked over and smiled. "Don't worry," he said. "You just need some new clothes." He took Zog to a clothing store and helped him choose jeans, a hoodie, and sneakers. After that, Zog was {5} to walk around the city without anyone looking at him. In his report, Zog wrote, "Earth people are kind, but their fashion changes very fast."

blanks.why: study human history「研究人類歷史」。hospital、weather、prize 和 human 搭配意思不通。
wear + 衣物「穿戴」：他穿著銀色斗篷、戴高帽和蛙鏡。fixed、married、missed a cape 意思不通。
That's crazy!「太誇張了吧！」，小男孩看到奇怪穿搭時的驚呼。able、own、least 不能單獨放在 That's 後面。
Was he safe here?「他在這裡安全嗎？」，因為大家都盯著他看。least、own、than 不能當補語。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：換了衣服後，他能在城裡走動而不被注意。own、least 不能接 to walk；asleep to walk 意思不通。

passages.zh: Zog 是一個來自紫色小行星的外星人。他的老師派他到地球研究人類歷史。出發前，Zog 讀了一些關於地球和地球時尚的老書。所以當他降落在台北時，他穿著一件長長的銀色斗篷，戴著一頂黑色高帽和一副蛙鏡。街上的人都停下來盯著他看。一個男孩指著他大喊：「也太誇張了吧！」Zog 很擔心，他不懂為什麼大家都在看他。他在這裡安全嗎？這時男孩走過來笑著說：「別擔心，你只是需要一些新衣服。」他帶 Zog 去服飾店，幫他挑了牛仔褲、帽T和運動鞋。之後，Zog 在城市裡走來走去，再也沒有人盯著他看了。Zog 在報告裡寫道：「地球人很友善，但他們的流行變得非常快。」

passages.title: 跑上陽台的猴子
passages.text: Last Saturday, a monkey escaped from the zoo near my house. The news said it wasn't {1}, but people should not try to touch it or feed it. That afternoon, I was eating a banana on our balcony when the monkey suddenly jumped onto the railing right in front of me! I was so scared that I {2} the banana. The monkey picked it up and ate it in three bites. Then it grabbed my dad's hat from a chair and {3} it on its head. It looked like a tiny old man. My little sister laughed like {4} and tried to take a photo. Ten minutes later, two zoo workers arrived with a net and caught the monkey. They told us we were {5} now, and that the monkey was just hungry. Dad never got his hat back, but he got a funny story to tell his friends.

blanks.why: wasn't dangerous「不危險」，但仍不要碰或餵牠。able、own、least 不能這樣形容動物。
drop + 物「把…弄掉」：我嚇到把香蕉掉了，猴子撿起來吃。wore、married the banana 意思不通；fixed 也不合情境。
wear + 物 + on one's head「把…戴在頭上」。married、missed、answered it on its head 意思不通。
laugh like crazy「笑到瘋掉、笑得很誇張」。like able、like own、like least 都不通。
be safe「安全的」：工作人員說現在安全了。least、own、than 不能當補語放在 were 後面。

passages.zh: 上星期六，一隻猴子從我家附近的動物園逃了出來。新聞說牠不危險，但大家不要試著碰牠或餵牠。那天下午，我正在陽台上吃香蕉，那隻猴子突然跳上我面前的欄杆！我嚇得把香蕉掉了。猴子撿起香蕉，三口就吃光了。接著牠從椅子上抓起爸爸的帽子，戴在自己頭上，看起來就像一個小老頭。我妹妹笑到不行，還想拍照。十分鐘後，兩位動物園員工拿著網子趕到，抓住了猴子。他們告訴我們現在安全了，那隻猴子只是肚子餓。爸爸的帽子再也拿不回來了，但他多了一個可以跟朋友說的好笑故事。

passages.title: 十三歲才學會游泳
passages.text: I wasn't {1} to swim until I was thirteen. Every summer, my friends went to the beach or the pool, and I {2} all the fun. I just sat on the sand and watched. My parents said swimming in the sea without lessons was too {3}, and I agreed. Water scared me. So last summer, I finally took swimming lessons at the city pool. On the first day, I {4} huge goggles and a bright red swimming cap. I looked silly, but I didn't care. I was too nervous to put my face in the water. The coach gave me a float and said, "Don't be afraid. With this, you're {5}." Slowly, I learned to kick, breathe, and move my arms. After six weeks, I swam twenty-five meters by myself! This summer, I'm going to the beach with my friends, and I'm not sitting on the sand anymore.

blanks.why: be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：我到十三歲才會游泳。own、least 不能接 to swim；asleep to swim 意思不通。
miss the fun「錯過樂趣」：朋友去玩水，我只能在旁邊看。fixed、wore、married all the fun 意思不通。
too dangerous「太危險」：沒上過課就去海裡游泳太危險。able、own、least 不能這樣形容游泳。
wear goggles「戴蛙鏡」。fixed、married、missed huge goggles 意思不通。
you're safe「你很安全」：有浮板就不用怕。least、own、than 不能當補語。

passages.zh: 我到十三歲才會游泳。每年夏天，朋友們都去海邊或游泳池，而我錯過了所有樂趣，只能坐在沙灘上看。爸媽說沒上過課就去海裡游泳太危險，我也同意，因為我很怕水。所以去年夏天，我終於去市立游泳池上游泳課。第一天，我戴著超大的蛙鏡和亮紅色泳帽，看起來很蠢，但我不在乎。我緊張到不敢把臉放進水裡。教練給我一塊浮板說：「別怕，有這個你就很安全。」慢慢地，我學會了踢水、換氣和划手。六個星期後，我自己游完了二十五公尺！今年夏天，我要跟朋友去海邊，再也不要坐在沙灘上了。

passages.title: 機器人大賽
passages.text: Our school's robot team entered a city robot competition this year. Our robot, Bolt, had to pick up small balls and {1} them into a basket. We practiced for three months. But the night before the competition, Bolt suddenly stopped moving. We stayed at school until midnight to {2} it. Finally, we found the problem: one tiny wire had come loose. On the day of the competition, we all {3} matching orange T-shirts with Bolt's face on them. In the final round, Bolt picked up nine balls in a row. Everyone was cheering. But with the last ball, Bolt {4} the basket by one centimeter. We came in second. We were a little sad, but then the judges gave us a special award. They said our team was {5} to solve problems quickly and worked together very well.

blanks.why: drop + 物 + into …「把…放進／丟進…」：機器人要把球丟進籃子。marry、wear、miss them into a basket 意思不通。
fix + 物「修理」：我們留到半夜修機器人。miss、marry、wear it 意思不通。
wear T-shirts「穿 T 恤」。fixed、married、missed matching T-shirts 意思不通。
miss + 目標「沒射中、沒丟中」：最後一球差一公分沒進。fixed、wore、married the basket 意思不通。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：評審說我們能很快解決問題。own、least 不能接 to solve；asleep to solve 意思不通。

passages.zh: 今年我們學校的機器人隊參加了市內的機器人大賽。我們的機器人 Bolt 要撿起小球，再丟進籃子裡。我們練習了三個月。沒想到比賽前一晚，Bolt 突然不動了。我們在學校待到半夜修理它，終於找到問題：有一條很細的電線鬆掉了。比賽當天，我們都穿著印有 Bolt 臉的橘色隊服。決賽時，Bolt 連續撿起九顆球，大家都在歡呼。但最後一顆球，Bolt 差了一公分沒丟進籃子。我們得到第二名。雖然有點難過，但評審頒給我們一個特別獎。他們說我們隊能很快解決問題，而且合作得非常好。

passages.title: 鄭成功上舞台
passages.text: For our {1} project this term, my group chose Koxinga, one of the most famous people in Taiwan's past. I didn't want to {2} any important details, so I read three books about him. We learned that he sailed to Taiwan in 1661 with hundreds of ships and drove the Dutch away. Instead of making a boring poster, we decided to act out a short play. I played Koxinga. I {3} a paper helmet and a long robe made from my mom's old curtain. My friend Joe played the Dutch leader, and he wore a wig made of yellow yarn. In the middle of the show, my paper sword broke in half. Everyone laughed, but Joe quickly {4} it with tape in ten seconds, and we kept going. At the end, our teacher clapped and said we were {5} to make history fun for the whole class.

blanks.why: history project「歷史報告」，主題是台灣歷史人物鄭成功。hospital、weather、prize project 意思不通。
miss details「漏掉細節」：我不想漏掉重要細節，所以讀了三本書。fix、marry、wear details 意思不通。
wear a helmet and a robe「戴頭盔、穿長袍」。fixed、married、missed a paper helmet 意思不通。
fix + 物 + with tape「用膠帶修好」：Joe 十秒就把斷掉的劍黏好。wore、married、missed it with tape 意思不通。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：我們能讓全班覺得歷史很有趣。own、least 不能接 to make；asleep to make 意思不通。

passages.zh: 這學期的歷史報告，我們這組選了鄭成功，他是台灣歷史上最有名的人物之一。我不想漏掉任何重要的細節，所以讀了三本關於他的書。我們知道他在 1661 年帶著好幾百艘船航行到台灣，趕走了荷蘭人。我們沒有做無聊的海報，而是決定演一齣短劇。我演鄭成功，戴著紙做的頭盔，穿著用媽媽的舊窗簾做的長袍。我朋友 Joe 演荷蘭指揮官，戴著黃色毛線做的假髮。演到一半，我的紙劍斷成兩截。大家都笑了，但 Joe 十秒內就用膠帶把它黏好，我們繼續演下去。最後，老師鼓掌說，我們讓全班都覺得歷史變有趣了。

passages.title: 爺爺的老收音機
passages.text: My grandpa has an old radio that is older than my dad. It has a long {1} in our family. Grandpa bought it in 1975 with his first paycheck, and he has listened to it every morning since then. Last month, my little cousin was playing in the living room and {2} it on the floor. After that, it stopped working. Grandpa didn't get angry, but he looked very sad. He said he {3} the old songs he used to hear while drinking his tea. So I looked on the internet and found a small shop in Taichung that could {4} old radios. We took a train there together. The owner opened the radio and smiled. "They don't make them like this anymore," he said. After two hours, he was {5} to make it work again. On the train home, Grandpa held the radio on his lap like a baby.

blanks.why: have a long history「有很長的歷史」：這台收音機在我們家很久了。hospital、weather、prize 和 long 搭配意思不通。
drop + 物 + on the floor「把…摔到地上」：之後收音機就壞了。wore、married、missed it on the floor 意思不通。
miss + 事物「懷念」：爺爺懷念以前邊喝茶邊聽的老歌。fixed、wore、married the old songs 意思不通。
fix old radios「修理老收音機」。miss、marry、wear old radios 意思不通。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：老闆花兩小時讓它恢復正常。own、least 不能接 to make；asleep to make 意思不通。

passages.zh: 我爺爺有一台比我爸爸年紀還大的老收音機，它在我們家有很長的歷史。爺爺在 1975 年用第一份薪水買了它，從那以後每天早上都聽。上個月，我的小表弟在客廳玩，把它摔到地上，之後收音機就不能用了。爺爺沒有生氣，但看起來很難過。他說他很懷念以前一邊喝茶一邊聽的老歌。所以我上網找到台中一家會修老收音機的小店，我們一起搭火車過去。老闆打開收音機笑著說：「現在已經沒有人做這樣的收音機了。」兩個小時後，他讓收音機又能響了。回家的火車上，爺爺把收音機抱在腿上，像抱著一個小嬰兒一樣。

passages.title: 差點錯過的演唱會
passages.text: My sister is {1} about a Korean pop group. When they came to Taipei, she waited online for three hours and finally got two tickets for us. On the day of the concert, she {2} a T-shirt with all five members' faces on it. But on the way there, our MRT train stopped between stations for forty minutes because of a problem. My sister was so worried. She kept saying, "We'll {3} the first song!" When we finally arrived, we ran all the way to the gate. My sister was so excited that she {4} her light stick on the stairs, and it rolled away. Luckily, a girl behind us picked it up and gave it back. We did miss the first song, but we were {5} to enjoy the rest of the show. My sister screamed so much that she lost her voice for two days.

blanks.why: be crazy about + 事物「非常迷…」：姊姊超迷一個韓團。able、own、least about a group 意思不通。
wear a T-shirt「穿 T 恤」。fixed、married、missed a T-shirt 意思不通。
miss the first song「錯過第一首歌」，因為捷運停了四十分鐘。fix、wear、marry the first song 意思不通。
drop + 物「把…弄掉」：她太興奮，手燈掉在樓梯上滾走了。wore、married、missed her light stick on the stairs 意思不通。
be able to + 動詞「能夠…」：我們還是能看完剩下的表演。own、least 不能接 to enjoy；asleep to enjoy 意思不通。

passages.zh: 我姊姊超迷一個韓國流行團體。他們來台北時，她在網路上等了三個小時，終於搶到兩張票。演唱會當天，她穿著一件印有五位成員臉的 T 恤。可是在去的路上，捷運因為故障停在兩站之間四十分鐘。姊姊急死了，一直說：「我們會錯過第一首歌！」終於到站後，我們一路跑到入口。姊姊太興奮了，應援手燈掉在樓梯上滾走了。幸好後面一個女生幫忙撿起來還給她。我們真的錯過了第一首歌，但還是好好享受了剩下的表演。姊姊尖叫到失聲了兩天。

passages.title: 玻璃鞋的疑問
passages.text: Everyone knows the story of Cinderella. With help from her fairy godmother, she {1} a beautiful dress and glass shoes to the prince's party. At midnight, she ran away and {2} one of her shoes on the stairs. The prince looked for her all over the kingdom with that shoe. When he found her, he {3} her the next week, and they lived happily ever after. But my friend Amy and I have some questions. First, if the shoe fit Cinderella perfectly, why did it fall off? Second, glass shoes are {4}! If one breaks, you could cut your feet badly. Amy says Cinderella was {5} to dance in them all night. "Next time," Amy said, "she should ask her fairy godmother for sneakers." I think that would make a much funnier story.

blanks.why: wear a dress and shoes to + 場合「穿…去參加」。fixed、married、missed a dress 意思不通。
drop + 物「掉了…」：她跑走時把一隻鞋掉在樓梯上。married、answered、missed one of her shoes on the stairs 意思不通。
marry + 人「和某人結婚」：王子找到她，隔週就娶了她，從此過著幸福快樂的日子。wore、fixed、traveled her 意思不通。
be dangerous「危險的」：玻璃鞋破了會割傷腳。able、own、least 不能這樣形容鞋子。
be crazy to + 動詞「做…真是瘋了」：穿著玻璃鞋跳整晚的舞太瘋狂。own、least、below 不能放在 was 後面接 to dance。

passages.zh: 大家都知道灰姑娘的故事。在仙女教母的幫忙下，她穿著漂亮的禮服和玻璃鞋去參加王子的舞會。午夜時，她匆匆離開，把一隻鞋掉在樓梯上。王子帶著那隻鞋找遍了整個王國。找到她後，王子隔週就娶了她，兩人從此過著幸福快樂的日子。但我和朋友 Amy 有幾個疑問。第一，如果那隻鞋完全合灰姑娘的腳，為什麼會掉下來？第二，玻璃鞋很危險！要是破了，腳可能會被割傷得很嚴重。Amy 說灰姑娘穿著它跳一整晚的舞真是瘋了。「下次，」Amy 說，「她應該跟仙女教母要一雙運動鞋。」我覺得那樣的故事會好笑得多。

passages.title: 爸爸的吉他
passages.text: My parents got {1} twenty years ago today. My brother and I wanted to give them a special surprise. Dad had an old guitar in the closet. One string was broken, and he hadn't played it {2} I was born. So last week, we secretly took it to a music shop and had it {3}. That evening, Mom {4} the same blue dress from their first date, and we had dinner at home with candles on the table. After dinner, my brother brought out the guitar. Dad couldn't believe his eyes. passages.zh: 爸媽在二十年前的今天結婚。我和哥哥想給他們一個特別的驚喜。爸爸的衣櫃裡有一把舊吉他，有一條弦斷了，從我出生以後他就沒再彈過。所以上星期，我們偷偷把它拿到樂器行修好。那天晚上，媽媽穿上他們第一次約會時穿的那件藍色洋裝，我們在家裡點著蠟燭吃晚餐。飯後，哥哥把吉他拿出來。爸爸不敢相信自己的眼睛，抱著吉他好久。接著，他彈起大學時常唱給媽媽聽的那首歌。媽媽哭了，爸爸也哭了。那天深夜，爸爸跟我們說他真的很懷念彈音樂的感覺。現在他每個週末都會彈吉他，媽媽就在旁邊跟著唱。
